sourceFile: 4. BRS-161016(DT) Report TEST new JIG improve use new dry machine 2024.04.05_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source context but changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for Ask AI evidence.
issues: Primary changed factor is misidentified as mixed materials, jig names, and row numbers.
Baseline/test condition is ambiguous; no prior normal machine or jig baseline is cited.
Outcome tables are over-split and include invalid derived measurement candidates from headers or count rows.
Key grouping factors such as time, material, jig type, shift, and trial number are not preserved consistently.
Evidence row existence passed, but citations do not support many generated statistics.
requiredUserQuestions: Should this be treated as new dry machine plus improved jig validation, or only as internal setting comparison within the new setup?
correctionPlan: Redefine changed factor from cited title, purpose, and content rows.
Separate subgroup keys for material, time, jig type, shift, and trial number.
Keep valid NG/OK rate results and tension test results; remove header-derived measurement outcomes.
Do not claim a baseline unless prior machine/jig evidence is present.
Rebuild concise evidence rows around table headers and actual data rows only.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient for final evidence until grouping and invalid stats are corrected.
